newsitem.title: USA: Worldport plan proposed for Denver International.
newsitem.headline: Worldport plan proposed for Denver International.

text.p: A group of developers says there is strong tenant interest in a proposed 72-acre mixed-use WorldPort it proposes to build at Denver International Airport (DIA), the local airport authority said in a statement.
It added that negotiations for construction of the centre are being finalized with the developers.

WorldPort at DIA, marketed by the development group L.C. Fulenwider, Inc, William K. Prather and Christopher Thompson, is intended to attract just-in-time inventory delivery companies, cargo warehouses, air freight forwarders, U.S. customs brokers and other aviation related businesses, the authority said. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
